localizedText.description: Text keyed by language code, e.g. de, en, pt-BR. 'de', the language of the printed cards, is required as fallback.

type.description: poison: the boss gets this many poison tokens. health_loss (the red heart): the hero who plays the card loses this much health. direct_damage (the broken heart): this much damage goes straight to the boss's health, past its shields. take_from_pile (a deck with two arrows): the player takes this many cards of their choice from their draw pile. remove_from_game (a card ripped in half): after it is played, the card is out of the game for the rest of the fight; its strength is not used, use 0. special (the *): the card has a special effect, see its effect text and ability; its strength is not used, use 0.

damage_type.description: For attacks and supports only: which of the boss's shields the damage hits first.

qr.description: Unique card ID, printed as a QR code. 1-15 characters: letters, digits and _ - + / = (so base64 values like BAEAAA== work).

race.description: Makes this a character card: players show it during onboarding to choose this race.

hero_class.description: Makes this a class card: players show it during onboarding to choose this class.

title.description: Left out for cards without a title.

ability.description: What the card does beyond its symbols: the id of a script in scripts/abilities/, such as free_play. On a character or class card, what the hero's level gives them for the whole fight. See docs/cards.md.

ability_values.description: Values for the ability, such as { "cards": 1 }. The ability's script says which it reads.

tags.description: What kind of card it is, for rules that care, such as totem or form (see docs/cards.md).

uses_per_fight.description: How often each hero can use this card in a fight, such as a potion. Left out for no limit.
